responsibility: Implements the low-level output side for writing LTO sections. It begins and ends assembler sections through lang_hooks, optionally wraps section payloads in the LTO compression stream, writes raw data or buffered output streams, and provides simple-section emission helpers for IPA passes. The file also manages lto_out_decl_state lifetimes and the stack of active declaration-stream encoders, recording per-function decl states so later whole-file emission can write the decl directory and associated global/function declaration streams.
